title: Nat Cole's television show
summary: Cole put him in his studio band for a year and recorded Caravan; Rose says the show ended because of prejudice.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: And how about working with Nat Cole? How long did you work with him?

I did the whole -- because him and his wife and family, we were all very good friends, you know; we used to go to their house or they used to come here for dinner or something like that. We were very good friends. So he put me in the show with the band in the studio, and in a way, the studio trombone player couldn't work because Nat Cole put me in there, you know?
So I worked the whole show the whole year with him, and he even recorded Caravan.
And you remember, the only reason his show left the air was because of prejudice. You remember when that happened?
He was a little ahead of his time.
